title: Stabilize per-request metrics proxy and deterministic sampling for inference KPIs
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Problem: The current per-request metrics proxy exhibits non-deterministic sampling and occasional duplicate counters when under backpressure from edge aggregators. This causes noisy per-route latency & error dashboards and makes SLOs flaky for Dedicated/Private customers.

Goal: Implement deterministic sampling keyed to stable request fingerprints, harden the proxy fanout logic to avoid duplicate writes for Prometheus-compatible exporters, and add a tenant-aware admission policy so high-cardinality tenants do not overwhelm the pipeline. Deliver a migration plan that keeps dashboards reliable during rollout.

Scope: proxy code that receives OTLP/HTTP metric envelopes at the edge, the sampling component (library), small changes to our prom-bridge adapter to support idempotent writes, unit/integration tests, dashboards to validate, and a canary rollout for Dedicated regions.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic 1:100 sampling produces identical sample sets for identical request fingerprints across restarts (unit test coverage).
No duplicate metric increments emitted by the proxy under synthetic backpressure scenarios (load test).
Prometheus bridge accepts idempotent markers and downstream dashboards show <1% variance in per-route latency compared to baseline after rollout (canary).
Tenant admission policy prevents more than one high-cardinality tenant from exceeding configured cardinality allowance and logs are produced for blocked tenants.
End-to-end tracing hooks include the proxy fingerprint ID so latency attribution links traces <-> metrics reliably.
Feature gated behind observability.feature.per_request_proxy and rollbackable with config toggle.
technical_plan:
1) Introduce a lightweight request fingerprint: stable fields = model_id, route_id, client_tenant, request_seed (hash of first 256 bytes of prompt). Normalize ordering and salt with environment-specific key.
2) Implement deterministic reservoir sampling library (shared-go) keyed by fingerprint so samples are reproducible across hot restarts.
3) Add idempotency token to emitted metric envelopes so prom-bridge can dedupe duplicates; prom-bridge switches to upsert semantics for counters when token present.
4) Implement tenant admission controller: sliding-window cardinality estimator + strict quota enforcement that converts metrics from high-cardinality tenants into aggregated fallbacks when exceeded.
5) Expose fingerprint as trace attribute and add trace hook in proxy to forward trace_id -> fingerprint mapping to our trace-metric joiner.
6) Add feature flagging and config knobs (sample_rate, cardinality_quota, dedupe_window_ms).
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Merge feature under feature flag; run unit tests and e2e in CI cluster.
Stage 1: Enable in internal staging for 48h with synthetic load and compare dashboards to baseline (canary group).
Stage 2: Canary to 5% of hosted traffic for 72h; monitor per-route latency variance, duplicate counter rate, and CPU of proxy nodes.
Stage 3: Gradual ramp to 50% over 7 days if metrics stable; enable tenant admission warnings for ops to review.
Stage 4: Global enable and tombstone legacy dedupe heuristics after 30 days of stable telemetry.
test_plan: Unit tests for deterministic sampler (multi-process reproducibility).
Integration test: proxy -> prom-bridge idempotent flow using local minikube harness.
Load test: synthetic high-cardinality tenant flood to verify admission controller and fallback aggregation.
Chaos test: restart proxy during inflight bursts to assert no sampling divergence and no duplicated counters.
Regression dashboards: Per-route p50/p95/p99, duplicate_counter_rate, dropped_envelopes, proxy_cpu, prom_bridge_latency.
migration_steps: Deploy sampler and idempotency token generation behind flag (no-op downstream).
Deploy prom-bridge update supporting dedupe token in backward-compatible mode (new token ignored if absent).
Run staging validation and load tests, tune default sample_rate to match historical ingestion budget.
Enable feature flag for <5% canary, monitor, iterate on sample_rate/cardinality_quota.
After stable run, flip flag for remaining traffic and deprecate legacy heuristics in config.
